overview: A DeFi pool analytics dashboard with a new Yield Farming page that lists reward-paying pools and estimates deposit earnings.
features: Yield Farming page listing pools that pay reward incentives
Base, reward and total APY with reward share and risk score per farm
Search, filter by chain, minimum TVL and stablecoin-only, and sort, shareable through the page link
Earnings estimator showing daily, monthly and yearly projections
Visible Demo data label on fallback data
